The Defective Detective — Album 5: Serah Asks

Bare Bear

"Bare bear Under all the metal"

[Verse 1] Steel in the hallway Heavy steps Conversations disappear Calus passes through the doorway And every spine remembers fear

Towering frame Augmented shoulders Voice kept low and words kept spare Platinum Eight Infrastructure Nobody jokes when he is there

At least not yet

[Pre-Chorus] Doors stay open Systems running Schedules clean and numbers fair Nobody sees the other version Nobody sees the bare bear

[Chorus] Bare bear Under all the metal Under every silent stare Bare bear Knows whose child is sick at home Knows who cannot pay for care Bare bear Leaves the food Leaves the gift Never waits to hear a prayer Somewhere underneath the armor There is always something there

[Verse 2] Gold and Bronze Copper workers Every station gets the same Calus learns the names beneath him Learns the families with the name

Someone misses three night shifts Someone’s partner cannot work Someone’s daughter has a birthday Someone’s pantry looking bare

Nothing public Nothing written Nothing tied to Platinum hands Boxes simply reach a doorstep Bills get lighter where they stand

Then Monday comes

And nobody says a word

[Pre-Chorus] Visitors enter Postures straighten Every joke becomes repair Calus turns to iron silence

Then the outsiders clear

And someone shouts

“You bought six lunches?”

[pause]

Calus shrugs

“One seemed insufficient.”

[Chorus] Bare bear Under all the metal Under every silent stare Bare bear Knows whose child is sick at home Knows who cannot pay for care Bare bear Leaves the food Leaves the gift Never waits to hear a prayer Somewhere underneath the armor There is always something there

[Verse 3] Once there was another shadow Bigger paws and colder eyes Rex could freeze a council chamber Just by walking through the lights

Calus only knew him softer Home meant soup and worn-out chairs Parents gone while still a young cub No one else was waiting there

Rex taught silence Rex taught duty Rex taught how a seat is held Never shame the Kin who serve you Never let their hunger swell

And when the council called him monster Rex would let them think it true Because fear made meetings shorter

And kindness had more work to do

[Break] Then came Ava

Questions rising Old foundations pushed too far Rex agreed more than he admitted Saw the fractures where they are

He almost spoke Almost stood there Almost chose the louder road

Then Ava vanished

Family with her

Names erased beneath the code

[pause]

Rex came home quieter

No speeches No rebellion No heroic final stand

Just one lesson left for Calus

“Take care of your people.”

[Verse 4] So Calus learned the same survival Duty wrapped around restraint Help the ones within your reach Never show where fear is faint

He inherited the office Inherited the weight Inherited the terrifying face Inherited the wait

And every worker in his section Knows the rule without a sign Outside eyes mean work and silence Inside doors mean jokes and time

Nobody tells the Company Nobody has to say why

Some secrets live because a workplace Decides a kindness should survive

[Final Chorus] Bare bear Under all the metal Under every silent stare Bare bear Carries Rex inside the hallway Carries everything from there Bare bear Not a rebel Not a savior Not pretending systems care Just a Kin who learned from silence

Help the people in your care

Bare bear Heavy footsteps Softest hands you never see Terrifying in the council

Then bringing birthday cake at three

[Outro] A visitor leaves the department

Silence holds

Door shuts

Someone laughs

Calus sets a wrapped box down

“For Mina’s son.”

A Copper worker smiles

“You remembered?”

Calus looks away

“Obviously.”

[pause]

Then the hallway hears his footsteps

And everybody stands straight again
